name: Blaze
effect: When HP is below one-third of its maximum, the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves is boosted.

name: Levitate
effect: The Pokémon is immune to damaging Ground-type moves and is treated as ungrounded for battlefield effects that care about grounding.

name: Magician
effect: If the Pokémon damages a target with a move while not holding an item, it steals the target's held item.
